recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not add Media guidance back to Observation unless the work group reintroduces Media or explicitly asks for release-history text; evaluate any future wording against active DocumentReference, DiagnosticReport, ImagingStudy/ImagingSelection, and Observation guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-12656 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 OO change request asking to add text describing Media's relationship to Observation in the Boundaries section.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly names FHIR-12656. The same change family was applied by commit 1f8156067a07341db5f660a2ac4a0f55c4bcb1a6 for FHIR-12657, which added Media Boundaries text saying Media captures a specific type of Observation whose value is audio, video, or image data and is preferred when its metadata is relevant.
additional_context: Media is no longer active in the current core build: source/fhir.ini lists Observation in [resources] but has no active media=Media entry. Later GF#19250/FHIR-19250 history removed Media from fhir.ini and removed Observation's Media narrative, and FHIR-38950 moved useful Media boundary information into DocumentReference.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing Media-specific Observation text would point current implementers at a retired/out-of-build resource; the active source already covers the successor model through DocumentReference, Observation.derivedFrom, valueAttachment guidance, and DiagnosticReport media/presentedForm guidance.

related_jiras.note: The Media event-alignment issue carried and applied the exact Observation/Media boundary wording.
A later published issue reopened Media/valueAttachment boundaries and transferred Media to OO for differentiation.
The Media-to-DocumentReference direction removed Media from active resources and removed Observation's Media-specific narrative.
The later DocumentReference issue explicitly carried useful Media boundary relationship text forward after Media and DocumentReference were merged.
